limitations: CC-R11 is a private research proof, not a public or stable compiler API, wire format, package, release, or general LinkML compatibility contract.
The public Assent runtime still uses the legacy candidate and graph-base path. No production cutover, migration, or second accepted-state authority is claimed.
Current replay proves structural initial population and current-state queries, not public bitemporal query semantics or correction, update, and delete behavior.
The RET-010 mapping is fixture-local. No public mapping DSL, GraphRecipe, OTTR, Prolog, richer policy adapter, external effect, observation, or Semantic Re-entry path is delivered.
Cross-language conformance remains unproven because no second interpreter executes the same artifacts yet.
The full repository pytest run was not completed for Milestone 3 under the selected Pareto gate. The focused boundary and independent audit are the completion evidence.
Package, wheel, and release checks were deliberately excluded and no package metadata changed.
Pre-existing modified research files and untracked design and handover files are outside CC-R11 and remain untouched.
